subtitles.en: I keep feeling that I have lost something.
A memory that ought to have been mine.
A memory of a culture.
As if someone had drawn it away.
Why has it all gone dark?
What is going on?
At last, you begin to feel it.
Who are you?
Who I am is of no importance.
What matters is what you have lost.
What have I lost?
You have lost a fragment of memory.
A memory of wood.
But I remember nothing at all.
It is not that you do not remember.
It is that you have never lived it.
But your body remembers.
I am here to help you.
You are here to help me reclaim my memory.
Not to reclaim it.
But to lead you through it once again.
Follow me.
To lay your hands on wonders that span a thousand years.
And if I follow you?
What will happen then?
You will understand everything.
Including why it was I who came to find you.
Are you ready?
